name: evensurface-paginate
description: A framework-independent, ORM-agnostic offset pagination package.

scripts.pack: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate pack --pack-destination .artifacts && pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate-drizzle pack --pack-destination .artifacts && pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate-better-auth pack --pack-destination .artifacts
scripts.pack:dry-run: pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate-drizzle pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @evensurface/paginate-better-auth pack --dry-run
scripts.validate: pnpm check:packages && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify:exports

author: Evensurface
